subject: maths
question: A group of men decided to do a job in 6 days, but 18 men dropped out every day. If the job was completed in 8 days, then how many men initially decided to do the job.
solution:
Given:

A group of men decided to do a job in 6 days, but 18 men dropped out every day. 

The job was completed in 8 days.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency of each worker × Number of days to finish × Number of total workers
